# How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

> Free UK self-employed tax calculator: enter income and expenses to see income tax, Class 4 National Insurance, student loan, payments on account and how much of every invoice to set aside. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
